params.frame_count_rule: 每相 max(1, floor(ms*fps/1000+0.5))；相内帧均分；关键帧取在帧边界上且含终点（关键帧数 = 帧数 + 1），与 sprite 版同一帧划分

convention.root_bone: hips (position curve = ground-solved pelvis position; prefab root stays at the feet origin)
convention.foot: foot bone counter-rotates so the sole stays parallel to the hips frame
